tapeLine: Tuesday 10 November: S&P 500 −0.4% to 7,520.93; Dow −0.3% to 52,231.89; Nasdaq Composite −0.7% to 25,065.87, per close reports dated 10–11 Nov. Early Wednesday futures were reported higher (see overnight).
matters:
October CPI, released Tuesday, rose 0.4% seasonally adjusted against a 0.3% consensus; core rose 0.3%. The BLS did not publish a year-over-year rate because last year’s government shutdown left it without the October 2025 comparison data. Coverage dated 10 Nov framed the print as strengthening the case for a December Fed rate increase.

Stocks gave back part of Monday’s rebound on the print, with Nvidia again cited as a drag. Early Wednesday, futures were reported higher after a CoreWeave revenue beat. The US bond market is closed today for Veterans Day, so there is no Treasury read on the inflation news until Thursday.

calendar.event: US bond market closed for Veterans Day (SIFMA recommendation); stock exchanges open normally; bond trading resumes Thu 12 Nov

alsoOnTape: Gold, VIX, oil and 10-year yield levels were not found with a clean dated source and are not carried. Bank of America and Axios published estimated annual CPI rates; they are estimates, not BLS figures, and are not carried as data.
overnight: Latest confirmed close — Tuesday 10 November: S&P 500 7,520.93 (−0.4%); Nasdaq Composite 25,065.87 (−0.7%); Dow 52,231.89 (−0.3%).

Wednesday futures — an early-morning snapshot cited from Investing.com had Nasdaq 100 futures +1.5%, S&P 500 futures +0.6% and Dow futures +0.2%. Other reports gave slightly different figures at other timestamps.
CoreWeave — reported to be rising premarket after third-quarter revenue beat estimates.
macro: October CPI (BLS, 10 Nov) — headline +0.4% m/m SA vs 0.3% expected; September was +0.6%. Core +0.3% m/m. No official annual rate published.
Fed — reports dated 10–11 Nov said the print raised expectations of a December rate hike; a probability figure was seen only in an unattributed summary and is not carried.
Nvidia — cited again as weighing on tech Tuesday amid reports about its CEO; the underlying allegation remains unconfirmed here.
flow: Breadth, dealer gamma, put-call and skew are paid data and are not on this page.

regime.tag: A hot monthly inflation print interrupted Monday’s rebound; rate-hike expectations are back in focus.
regime.sizing: Whether early Wednesday’s futures strength survives the cash open is unresolved, and bonds give no signal today.

secondOrder: With the bond market shut, today’s equity session trades the CPI news without a same-day Treasury reaction; Thursday is the first chance to see one. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: The prior brief made no direction call and said whether Monday’s rebound would hold was unresolved. Tuesday gave back part of it: S&P 500 −0.4%, Nasdaq −0.7%. Nothing directional was called, so there is nothing to grade right or wrong.
Yield behaviour still cannot be graded: no dated, sourced yield levels were found, and the bond market is closed today.
